title: GPU + Network Handoff — brain dump
content:
Quick brain-dump for handoff to night shift — things I did, things to watch, TODOs. Kept intentionally messy so I can iterate tomorrow.

Context: evening maintenance window — partial drain of gpu-pool-a (t4x) to apply NIC firmware + kernel backports on the node set. Also rebalanced dedicated workloads into reserved-pool-b for the weekend stress test.

Snapshot (approx):
- gpu-pool-a: 18/24 healthy (3 draining, 3 offline for firmware). target spare: 2 nodes.
- reserved-pool-b: steady, 12/12 live (no immediate action).
- avg-token-latency (p99) for hosted-inference-route /v1/generate: 420ms -> after partial drain peaked at 680ms for ~6m.

What I changed/why:
- kicked NIC firmware roll on nodes: rack-r19-u07, r19-u08, r20-u02. Mellanox 4.28 -> 4.30, small regression noted on RX interrupts on u07 (more dropped packets). Rolling back driver on u07 to 4.28 resolved drops.
- updated kernel backport for skb handling (patch from infra-kernel-update branch) on r20-u02. Verified via dmesg (no OOMs).
- adjusted autoscaler threshold for gpu-pool-a to 75% util -> 82% for 30m window during maintenance to avoid aggressive shrink; will revert after window.
- created temporary route policy: route-to-dedicated on congestion (if queue depth > 120) for hosted-api. Config id: route-ephemeral-03.

Open/fragile items to track:
- r19-u07 packet drops: keep 4xx alerts in watch for next 24h. If reappears, escalate to hw-ops (ticket INFRA-2389).
- autoscaler tweak might leave <2 spare nodes if spike occurs; if you see >10% 5m error for /v1/chat, manually set min-pool to 4 (CLI: rictl pool set-min gpu-pool-a 4).
- KV cache warmup: after re-add of nodes, cache misses spike. Warmup plan: run lightweight prefix jobs (scripts/cache-warmup-mini.sh) against node label warmup=true. Do not run full warmup during peak hours.

Handoff checklist (what I'd want morning to verify):
- [ ] confirm INFRA-2389 status updated (if not resolved, add escalate tag)
- [ ] check p99 latency for top 3 customer routes (hosted chat, rerank, embeddings)
- [ ] validate pool counts: gpu-pool-a >= 4 spares after autoscaler reverts
- [ ] confirm no crashloops on r20-u02 after kernel backport (kubectl -n infra get pods -o wide)
- [ ] review prometheus alerts: NIC_RX_DROPS > 0 on r19-u07 should be 0; if >10/s open pager
- [ ] ensure route-ephemeral-03 disabled by 08:00 if traffic normal

Quick commands I ran (save for debugging):
- ssh ops@r19-u07 'journalctl -u mlx-driver -n 200'
- rictl node drain r19-u07 --grace-period=300 --delete-local-data --ignore-daemonsets
- rictl pool set-autoscaler gpu-pool-a --scale-out-threshold=0.82 --window=30m
- ./scripts/check-kernel-patches.sh --node r20-u02 --verify

Notes to self / lessons learned:
- firmware updates should be staggered with at least 20m between nodes in the same rack to spot cross-node NIC noise.
- autoscaler heuristics are good but during maintenance they fight with manual drains; prefer explicit min-pool for short windows.
- add a small canary job that exercises KV cache on new nodes immediately after join (a single 5k token walk that touches frequent prefixes).

Unresolved questions / followups:
- Can we get an automated post-firmware test that runs NIC RX/TX microbench and reports to the infra dashboard? (file a project?)
- Should we extend kernel backports to a subset of reserved-pool-b as pretest before mass rollout?
- Who owns scheduling of route-ephemeral policies long-term (I think product-routing team, need to confirm) — tag @gabi for follow-up.

If you see pager: first triage steps (short):
1) check pool health (rictl pool status gpu-pool-a)
2) look at queue depth metric (infra.queue.depth / route)
3) flip route-ephemeral-03 off (rictl route disable route-ephemeral-03)
4) if node-level NIC drops, cordon + drain and roll back to driver 4.28

Extras / small scribbles:
- Reminder: update confluence runbook with the kernel backport command sequence (copy from infra-kernel-update README).
- TODO: draft runbook PR for automated warmup job template (name: cache-warmup-mini)
- Coffee: buy team donuts Friday if maintenance window completes cleanly :)

End of dump. Ping me in DM if anything critical.

-- Amar
